categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches Wallet label, modifies src/wallet/wallet.cpp, and directly fixes legacy-to-descriptor wallet migration.
categories.rationale: Fixes a legacy-to-descriptor migration failure and unhandled exception when migrating watch-only legacy wallets with transactions. Per the wallet category rubric, correctness of the legacy-to-descriptor migration path is high priority, and this resolves issue #36483 where in-memory transactions were not cleared prior to pre-commit checks.
